title: Headline Wall
summary: Headlines, tweets and search cards pin themselves to the wall behind the speaker.
description: A collage of press-style cards slaps onto the wall behind the speaker one after another with a quick overshoot: paper headlines in bold serif, italic quotes, tweets, Google-style search pills, black POV cards, chat bubbles and notifications. A bigger hero card lands last and a yellow highlighter swipes across its key word. The speaker is cut out and stays in front. With no cards given, the content is written from the clip's transcript.

options.cards: "auto" (written from the transcript) or a list of cards. Each card: {"type": "note" | "quote" | "tweet" | "search" | "pov" | "bubble" | "notify", "text": "..."} plus optional "kicker" (small caps line on notes), "name" / "handle" (tweet author, quote byline, notification app), "highlight" (word to mark yellow), "hero": true (the big card that lands last). Order = order they appear; the first cards get the most visible spots
options.count: how many cards auto mode writes (8-12 fills the wall)
options.at: when the first card lands (seconds or "@word")
options.stagger: frames between cards (2-4 = rapid-fire, 6+ = one by one)
options.heroDelay: extra frames before the hero card lands
options.outAt: optional: when the cards pop off (null = hold to the end; they also leave automatically when an effect window ends early)
options.columns: card columns across the wall (3 = reference look, 4 = smaller, denser cards)
options.wallBottom: "auto" (from the speaker's head) or a 0-1 fraction: how far down the cards reach
options.dim: darken the room behind the cards a little so they pop (0 = off, 0.25 = subtle)
